RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor and nine City Council members are independently elected. Seven council members are elected by district, and two are elected at-large (positions 8 and 9). The City Attorney and Municipal Judges are also independently elected. Information on City Council members and other elected officials was primarily sourced from the official seattle.gov website's 'Elected Officials' and 'City Council' pages, which are considered the most current and authoritative.
